text:
jessica: ACME reporting 403s hitting /sso/acs after they rotated IdP signing cert. Only seeing it via our eu-west edge. Can someone triage?
raj: On it. Do we have any logs or repro steps from them?
jessica: They sent SAMLResponse + relaystate. Server log shows: 
```
ERROR SAML: AudienceRestrictionFailed - expected 'https://redwood.prod.sso/acs' but assertion audience was 'https://sso.acme/acs'
Request: tenant=acme id=abc123 src=edge-eu-west
```
They claim nothing changed in their ACS URL.
lee_sre: Two quick suspects: 1) X-Forwarded-Host / host rewrite at proxy causing our recipient/host normalization to mismatch; 2) metadata/cert fetch problems after key rollover. Any request headers from the failing traffic?
jessica: Pasted raw headers from edge logs: 
```
Host: internal-edge-1.redwood.local
X-Forwarded-Host: sso.acme
X-Forwarded-Proto: https
X-Forwarded-For: 18.204.1.5
User-Agent: ACME-SAML-Client/2.1
```
curl repro (redacted SAML):
```
curl -v 'https://edge-eu-west.redwood.com/sso/acs' \
  -H 'Host: internal-edge-1.redwood.local' \
  -H 'X-Forwarded-Host: sso.acme' \
  -d 'SAMLResponse=<BASE64_SAML>' \
  -d 'RelayState=...'
```
raj: I reproduced locally: when X-Forwarded-Host is set to sso.acme we hit AudienceRestrictionFailed. If I set X-Forwarded-Host to redwood.prod.sso the assertion is accepted. So our ACS recipient check is matching against X-Forwarded-Host first and that doesn't include the tenant canonical host.
mikeops: Customer rotated to an ECDSA key about 30m ago. Our metadata fetch logs show: 
```
metadata_fetch: https://idp.acme/metadata 200 OK content-encoding: gzip
parsed keys: [sha256:deadbeef..., sha1:ceaf...]
```
But the order of KeyDescriptors in the signed metadata changed and our parser picks the first signingKey — might have caused a short window where the old key was used by them but our cache updated to new/ordered key.
lee_sre: Two-step mitigation: 1) customer can add their expected ACS host variant to tenant allowed-recipients to avoid host-normalization mismatch (quick tenant bootstrap); 2) we'll patch recipient normalization to compare both Host and X-Forwarded-Host, and also check the raw Recipient values before strict normalization.
jessica: Workaround steps for ACME (run as tenant admin):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tenants/acme/allowed-recipients \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"recipients": ["https://sso.acme/acs", "https://redwood.prod.sso/acs"]}'
```
They can add the canonical acs plus the proxy-forwarded host.
raj: I'll monitor while they test. Also, we should confirm metadata parser ungzips before XML canonicalization — mike, can you take that?
mikeops: Yep, I'll open a quick PR to: 
- ensure Content-Encoding: gzip is inflated before XML parse
- prefer KeyDescriptor with use="signing" and explicit Signature over first-key heuristics
- add a short retry window to avoid swapping signing key mid-session
I'll link the PR here in a minute.
lee_sre: Quick patch to runtime recipient check is ready. Plan: deploy to staging, run ACME repro suite, then promote to prod if green. Targeting a small rollout (edge-eu-west only) to avoid blast radius.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: edge-recip-check-patch -> staging (job 9876). Estimated ~7m.
jessica: ACME applied the tenant workaround and reported staging succeeded: 200 on /sso/acs, assertion accepted. They will test end-to-end for 15m and confirm. :thumbsup:
raj: Monitoring alert threshold set: >5% 403s on tenant acme will page SRE. I've also added a temporary synthetic check hitting /sso/acs with their sample SAML.
mikeops: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/4321 — includes gzip fix + KeyDescriptor ordering guard.
lee_sre: If ACME stays green, I'll promote patch to prod (eu-west) in ~20m. Will coordinate with deploy-bot.
jessica: Customer confirmed green on staging. Thanks team. We'll keep the tenant workaround until prod rollout completes. I'll follow up once prod is live.
raj: Closing interim support loop, keeping incident ticket open until prod patch is live + 1h of stable metrics.
jessica: Noted. I'll update the customer and close the support ticket after prod ramp.
